BiblicalUsage: Gerar is a Philistine city, named 10 times in Scripture, in Genesis and 2 Chronicles. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Gerar seriously as a real place in God’s story, not a made-up one. That is why its name belongs in this study, even when the Bible says little about it.
RelatedEvents: Abraham and Abimelech; Asa's Victory over Zerah
